You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Regidice Regidice was born when Luke Badger accidentally typed Regidice instead of Regicide. 24 hours later, Paul Abrahams had given birth to the dice-based beast you see before you. Regidice was announced April 1st, 2021... Yes, April 1st. Regidice is a cooperative game where 1 to 4 players work together to defeat three powerful enemies. Players take turns to roll dice, pick actions and attack the three enemies, represented by black dice. Once enough damage is dealt, the enemy is defeated. The players win when the last enemy is defeated. But beware! Each turn the enemy strikes back. Players will discard dice to satisfy the damage and if they can't discard enough, everyone loses! Number of players: 1 - 4 Game duration: 25 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play Regidice and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Turns 3 Actions 4 Suffer Phase 5 Prepare Phase 6 Enemies Overview Defeat 3 enemies made up of 3 then 4 then 5 dice respectively. Co-Operative Play. Turns Simultaneously, all players roll their dice secretly for the round. The pips are secret, but the colours may be declared when asked. You then have the choice of 5 actions: Attack Block Heal Cast Animal You can take the same action as another player, but NOT at the same value. After which all dice are revealed and players take all dice from every player whose value matches the value they requested. e.g. if you request 3's, you get yours and all other players' 3's If at the end of the Action Phase the enemy is defeated, Suffer Phase is skipped and the enemy is moved into the players' dice pool Actions Attack For each set of dice you hold which equals the pips on the enemy dice cause 1 damage. e.g. if enemy dice are 1 1 1, every 3 pips of yours causes 1 damage. The enemy pips are counted at the start, so if multiple players are attacking, in this example it will be 3 pips per 1 damage for everyone, regardless of order. Block Sets of 3 of a kind block one damage +1 per extra dice. e.g. a set of 3 4's blocks 1 damage, a set of 5 2's blocks 1+2 3 damage Heal 3 consecutive values heal 1 dice from the injured pool +1 per extra dice. e.g. a run of 4 5 6 heal 1 dice, a set of 1 2 3 4 5 heals 1+2 3 dice Cast Using a single colour of your choice, match with the pips of the enemy dice to cast a spell based on colour used. e.g. if enemy dice are 1 1 1, you need three 1's, if enemy dice are 3 3 4, you need 2 3's and a 4 Red Spell - Deal 1 damage per dice used Yellow Spell - Heal 1 dice per dice used Blue Spell - Block 1 damage per dice used (Guaranteed complete block) Black Spell - Insta-kill the enemy (Only physically possible on final enemy, as only then would you have 7 dice of 5 required) Animal Use 1's to do a +1 to another player's dice, with multiple 1's you can do this multiple times e.g. 2 1's would give you a +2 or 2 separate +1's Suffer Phase After all players have taken their turn, the enemy fights back dealing their attack value to the group The enemy first tries to target Blocking players, then targets Attacking players, then targets Casting players, then targets Healing players, then finally targets Animal players If you have blocked, this reduces the attack you'll receive If you haven't blocked, or your block isn't sufficient, you'll lose dice equal to the difference If the target player cannot lose enough dice required, the team loses. There is no Suffer Phase if an enemy was just defeated during Action Phase. Prepare Phase If all players are still standing, each has the option to pass dice on to their left neighbour from those dice not used for their action. These dice are locked in place i.e. not re-rolled Enemies Enemy 1 has 18 health, 3 attack, 3-18 defence Enemy 2 has 24 health, 4 attack, 4-24 defence Enemy 3 has 30 health, 5 attack, 5-30 defence The defence is equal to the pips currently showing, so the more you attack it the more defensive it becomes When an enemy is defeated, the black dice go into injured pile, however if you dealt any extra overkill damage, the dice go directly into that player's dice pool. [Rating: 1/10] This game is broken. Which is a statement people make way too often but in this case is actually true hopefully this gets a reworking as really enjoy regicide the card game it is based on

[Rating: 1/10] Rules are far more complex then they need to be. Nearly impossible to heal. Gathering dice from other players often screws them but is also necessary. The whole thing is just a complete mess.

[Rating: 1/10] Game is trash.  Rules need to be completely overhauled or scrapped. Here's an idea, Damage reduces Pips instead of removing Dice. Meanwhile, just play Regicide

[Rating: 1.5/10] I think it's worth occasionally rating a very bad game just to keep everything in context. This game is the definition of half-baked.  Apparently the lore is that it was an April Fool's joke, but I'm not clear if its being so bad is intentionally part of the joke.

[Rating: 2/10] Regicide is one of the surprise games of the last few years for me. An absolute marvel and masterpiece of creativity with a standard 52-card deck. Stop reading this review and go play Regicide.   Regidice, on the other hand... it doesn't excuse anything to say it was an April Fools joke and released after only 3 days development. It simply condemns it. This game is extremely bad and an awful playing experience.  Please play Regicide instead.

[Rating: 3/10] BGA. Abhorrent. Nice and clever name being an anagram but we found it painful and ended up passing later rounds

[Rating: 3/10] I mean... it is a joke game. But that doesn't mean I want to play it more as a joke lol.

[Rating: 3/10] Played 2P on BGA. The game is simply not fun when you're unable to discuss the dice you rolled. No clever tactics can be employed, you simply gather dice of the value you think you need, and you have no idea if it screws up your partner's perfect play or if they even have dice of that value to take. Our game was incredibly long (over 1h30m) even when we gave up trying to hide our dice rolls so we had fewer wasted turns.  There are some interesting ideas here (casting different spells, saving unused dice but you have to pass them to someone else, etc), but they aren't well realized in this game

[Rating: 3/10] Interesting April Fools joke, but as a game it simply isn't very enjoyable. I could absolutely see a little dice chucker like this doing well, if it received more development.

[Rating: 3/10] For a dice rolling game Regidice is overly complicated and takes far too long.  Our four player session took almost 4 hours to complete, it was so ridiculous that near the halfway mark we all agreed to throw out the limited communication rule, while we didn’t outright declare what we rolled, but we weren’t about to extend our suffering any longer than we need to.  I didn’t think much of Regicide but at least it respected your time, this is just an atrocity that no one should play unless you hate the people you decide to introduce this to.
